title: That's the wrong order
setting: Back at the casual place with Jess. Plates have just landed. One is clearly not theirs; Chris's burger has onions on it.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Oh. Sorry, I think this is the wrong order.
lines.spoken: Oh. Sorry, I think this is the wrong order.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I asked for no onions. I think this is someone else's burger. It's got, like, everything on it, and also I did the grilled cheese.
lines.spoken: I asked for no onions. I think this is someone else's burger. It's got, like, everything on it, and also I did the grilled cheese.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Oh my god. Okay. Yeah, that's not yours. I'm so sorry. I'll fix that.
lines.spoken: Oh my god. Okay. Yeah, that's not yours. I'm so sorry. I'll fix that.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I think this one is mine, actually, but it has onions. Which is... yeah.
lines.spoken: I think this one is mine, actually, but it has onions. Which is... yeah.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: You said no onions. I wrote no onions. I'm really sorry. Let me just take both of these and I'll come right back.
lines.spoken: You said no onions. I wrote no onions. I'm really sorry. Lemme just take both of these and I'll come right back.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: It's okay. No rush, I just didn't want to start eating the wrong thing and then...
lines.spoken: It's okay. No rush, I just didn't want to start eating the wrong thing and then...

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: No, you're right to say something. Give me two minutes. Do you want me to put a rush on it?
lines.spoken: No, you're right to say something. Gimme two minutes. D'you want me to put a rush on it?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Only if it's easy. We're not dying.
lines.spoken: Only if it's easy. We're not dying.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: I'll put a rush on it anyway. Sorry again. This is on me.
lines.spoken: I'll put a rush on it anyway. Sorry again. This is on me.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: I appreciate that. I'll be right back.
lines.spoken: I appreciate that. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I was practicing in my head for a second. I didn't want to sound mad.
lines.spoken: I was practicing in my head for a second. I didn't want to sound mad.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You didn't. You sounded like a person who asked for no onions.
lines.spoken: You didn't. You sounded like a person who asked for no onions.

gist.askEn: What's wrong with the food that arrived?

accept: Jess is sorry and will fix it
she asked for no onions on a burger that isn't hers
那份带洋葱的汉堡不是她的

details.askZh: Jess 打算怎么补救？要不要催后厨？
details.askEn: How will Jess fix it, and will she rush it?

glue.span: I think this is the wrong order
glue.hear: I think this is the wrong order
glue.noteZh: I think this is the 一串功能词，wrong order 才是要点；说的时候要整句听，不要只抓住 wrong。
glue.standard: I think this is the wrong order

glue.noteZh: asked for no 里 for 弱读，no 才是否定；这是点餐改配料被忽略时最有用的原句。
right back 连读，t 常变成闪音，意思是‘我马上回来’，不是右边。

chunks.form: I think this is the wrong order.
chunks.sayAfter: Sorry, I think this is the wrong order.
I asked for no onions. This has everything on it.

chunks.meaningZh: 我来帮你改 / 我来处理。
chunks.sayAfter: Yeah, that's not yours. I'm so sorry. I'll fix that.

roleplay.setupZh: 菜上来了，但明显不是你点的，或者你交代过不要的配料还在上面。你要说清楚问题，保持礼貌，不要听起来在发火，也不要道歉到不敢改。
roleplay.aiRole: Jess, embarrassed and efficient, plus Chris who notices onions on his burger too. Jess will take the plates, offer a rush, and own the mistake. She is not defensive.
variants: The kitchen says the correct item will take 15 minutes.
mustUse: I think this is the wrong order
starters: Sorry, I think this is the wrong order.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲上错菜：两盘分别有什么问题，Maya 怎么开口，Jess 打算怎么补，为什么 Maya 刚才在脑子里先练了一遍。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the wrong-order moment: what was wrong with each plate, how Maya said it, how Jess offered to fix it, and why Maya had practiced the line in her head. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
